events.title: 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are refused permission to appoint caretaker manager Glenn Roeder on a permanent basis as he does not possess the required coaching qualifications.
Current 미들즈브러 manager 스티브 매클래런 signs a four-year contract agreeing to succeed 스벤예란 에릭손 as England head coach after the World Cup. The contract begins on 1 August.

사우스엔드 유나이티드, after defeating 브리스틀 시티, become League One champions, while 콜체스터 유나이티드 secure the second automatic place to the Championship after managing a draw at 요빌 타운 while 브렌트퍼드 can only draw away at 본머스 ; Colchester will play in the top two tiers in English football for the first time in their history after their promotion. Around the same time, both 하틀리풀 유나이티드 and 밀턴킨스 던스 are relegated to League Two after both teams can only draw while 로더럼 유나이티드 survive.

옥스퍼드 유나이티드 lose their league status after 44 years and are relegated from the football league following a 3–2 defeat by 레이턴 오리엔트, who are promoted to League One after their win while 그림즈비 타운 can only draw against already promoted 노샘프턴 타운.
선덜랜드 finish the season on 15 points, the lowest points total ever in top-flight English football since 3 points for a win was introduced in the 1981–82 season.
Roy Keane's testimonial is played at Old Trafford, with 맨체스터 유나이티드 beating 셀틱 1–0 thanks to a second half 크리스티아누 호날두 goal.

미들즈브러 lose the UEFA Cup final 4–0 to 세비야 in 스티브 매클래런's last game in charge at the Philips Stadion in Eindhoven . On the same day, the Premier League change their mind over the Glenn Roeder situation at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and give him permission to take on the manager's role on a permanent basis despite him not having the requiring coaching qualifications.
Alan Shearer's testimonial is played at St James' Park , with a 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 XI beating 셀틱 3–2, with Shearer scoring the winning penalty. Joe Royle leaves 입스위치 타운 "by mutual consent".
바이에른 뮌헨 win second Bundesliga title in a row.
리버풀 win the 125th FA Cup final beating 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–1 on penalties after a thrilling 3–3 draw after extra time .
안더레흐트 wins the Belgian First Division, their twenty-eighth in total.
링컨 시티 become the first team to lose four consecutive play-off competitions following a 3–1 aggregate defeat to neighbors 그림즈비 타운 in the League Two semi-finals.
아스널 lose in the UEFA Champions League final to 바르셀로나 2–1 in the Stade de France . 옌스 레만 is sent off controversially after fouling 사뮈엘 에토오 and 뤼도비크 지윌리 puts the ball into the back of the net.

바르셀로나 win the UEFA Champions League , defeating 아스널 2-1 in the final. 아스널 goalkeeper 옌스 레만 became the first player ever sent off in a Champions League final. 바르셀로나's goals were scored by Belletti and 사뮈엘 에토오 ; 아스널's goal was scored by Sol Campbell . (BBC) (SkySports)
바르셀로나 beat 아스널 2–1 in the Champions League Final .
헤리퍼드 유나이티드 gain promotion to League Two after beating Halifax Town 3–2 in the Conference Playoff Final , after extra time.
왓퍼드 gain promotion to the Premier League after defeating 리즈 유나이티드 3–0 in the Championship play-off final .
아스널 sign Tomáš Rosický from 도르트문트 for £6.8 million.
반즐리 win promotion to the Championship after overcoming 스완지 시티 in the League One play-off final. They win 4–3 on penalties after both sides remained level at 2–2 after extra time.
첼트넘 타운 win promotion to the League One by defeating 그림즈비 타운 1–0 in the League Two play-off final.
에버턴 pay a club record £8.6 million for 크리스털 팰리스 striker Andrew Johnson , and 첼시 sign 살로몽 칼루 from 페예노르트 for £8 million.
첼시 pay a national record £30 million for AC 밀란 and Ukraine striker Andriy Shevchenko .
